definitions.explanation: The state of being different or not the same. The noun form of the verb {違|ちが}う (to differ). Used to describe gaps or distinctions between things.

examples.japanese: {二|ふた}つの{製品|せいひん}の{違|ちが}いがわからない。
examples.english: I can't tell the difference between the two products.

examples.japanese: {文化|ぶんか}の{違|ちが}いを{理解|りかい}することが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: It's important to understand cultural differences.

examples.japanese: {考|かんが}え{方|かた}の{違|ちが}いで{意見|いけん}が{合|あ}わなかった。
examples.english: We couldn't agree due to differences in our ways of thinking.

notes:
USAGE: This is the noun form derived from the verb {違|ちが}う. It emphasizes the state or degree of being different.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・〜の{違|ちが}い (the difference in/of ~)
・{違|ちが}いがある (there is a difference)
・{違|ちが}いがわかる (to understand the difference)
・{大|おお}きな{違|ちが}い (big difference)
・{個人|こじん}{差|さ}/{違|ちが}い (individual differences)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{差|さ} - emphasizes the gap or margin between things (often numerical)
・{相違|そうい} - formal word for difference/discrepancy
・{区別|くべつ} - distinction, differentiation (the act of distinguishing)
